content: A hero is no braver than an ordinary man, but he is brave five minutes longer.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Heroism is not the absence of fear or supernatural strength; it is the sheer endurance to hold the line for just a few moments longer when others surrender.
practicalInsight: When tempted to quit today under pressure, persevere for just five more focused minutes.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your life do you need to cultivate the discipline to hold on 'five minutes longer'?
